name: PadChest: Chest X-ray and Radiology Reports Dataset
description: PadChest is a large-scale chest X-ray dataset from Hospital Universitario San Juan de Alicante (Spain) spanning 2009-2017. It contains over 160,000 chest radiographs from 67,000 patients along with associated Spanish clinical radiology reports labeled with 117 radiographic findings and 19 differential diagnoses mapped to UMLS concepts.
